theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.pieceA (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, hookZ μ c ^ 2 = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, contentZ c ^ 2 + ↑μ.cells.card ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.pairCount_holds (μ : YoungDiagram) :
PairCount μ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.swap_reindex (μ : YoungDiagram) (f : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ → ℤ) :
∑ pq ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells, f pq.swap = ∑ pq ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells, f pq

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_fst_eq_scLower (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ q ∈ μ.cells, ↑q.1 = ↑(scLowerPairs μ).card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_snd_eq_srLower (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ q ∈ μ.cells, ↑q.2 = ↑(srLowerPairs μ).card

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.scLowerPairs (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ)

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.srLowerPairs (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.fst_eq_card (μ : YoungDiagram) {q : ℕ × ℕ} (hq : q ∈ μ.cells) :
↑q.1 = ↑{A ∈ μ.cells | A.2 = q.2 ∧ A.1 < q.1}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.snd_eq_card (μ : YoungDiagram) {q : ℕ × ℕ} (hq : q ∈ μ.cells) :
↑q.2 = ↑{L ∈ μ.cells | L.1 = q.1 ∧ L.2 < q.2}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_prod_eq_ullr (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells, ↑p.1 * ↑p.2 = ↑(ullrPairs μ).card

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.ullrPairs (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.prod_eq_card (μ : YoungDiagram) {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ μ.cells) :
↑p.1 * ↑p.2 = ↑{a ∈ μ.cells | a.1 < p.1 ∧ a.2 < p.2}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_armLeg_eq_urll (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells, armZ μ p * legZ μ p = ↑(urllPairs μ).card

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.urllPairs (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.legZ_eq_card (μ : YoungDiagram) {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ μ.cells) :
legZ μ p = ↑{B ∈ μ.cells | B.2 = p.2 ∧ p.1 < B.1}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.armZ_eq_card (μ : YoungDiagram) {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ μ.cells) :
armZ μ p = ↑{R ∈ μ.cells | R.1 = p.1 ∧ p.2 < R.2}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.pieceA_of_pairCount (μ : YoungDiagram) (hpc : PairCount μ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, hookZ μ c ^ 2 = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, contentZ c ^ 2 + ↑μ.cells.card ^ 2

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.PairCount (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Prop

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.pieceA_reduction (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, hookZ μ c ^ 2 - ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, contentZ c ^ 2 = ↑μ.cells.card + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, armZ μ c * legZ μ c + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1 * ↑c.2 + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.2 + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_legZ_generic (μ : YoungDiagram) (F : ℤ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, F (legZ μ c) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, F ↑c.1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_swap_transpose (μ : YoungDiagram) (H : ℕ × ℕ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, H c.swap = ∑ d ∈ μ.transpose.cells, H d

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.legZ_eq_transpose_armZ (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
legZ μ c = armZ μ.transpose c.swap

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.sum_armZ_generic (μ : YoungDiagram) (F : ℤ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, F (armZ μ c) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, F ↑c.2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.armZ_eq_rowRefl_snd (μ : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
armZ μ c = ↑(rowRefl μ c).2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.rowRefl_invol (μ : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
rowRefl μ (rowRefl μ c) = c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.rowRefl_mem (μ : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
rowRefl μ c ∈ μ.cells

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.mem_cells_iff_snd_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
c ∈ μ.cells ↔ c.2 < μ.rowLen c.1

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.rowRefl (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℕ × ℕ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.legZ_nonneg (μ : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ) :
0 ≤ legZ μ c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.armZ_nonneg (μ : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ) :
0 ≤ armZ μ c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.hookZ_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
hookZ μ c = ↑(μ.rowLen c.1) + ↑(μ.colLen c.2) - ↑c.1 - ↑c.2 - 1

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.contentZ (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℤ

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.hookZ (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℤ

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.legZ (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℤ

def QOU.BraidKnot.PieceA.armZ (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℤ
